Package com.hkust.marketplace.services

Class OfferService

java.lang.Object
com.hkust.marketplace.services.OfferService
public class OfferService extends Object
UC5 Make Offer, for the Buyer (Task 1.5): a price offer on a sale listing, a borrow request on a lend listing, or a claim on a giveaway.

Design (Lecture 15). This is the use case's control class. Its boundary classes are the buyer's screens (controllers.buyer.MakeOfferFlow and its dialogs); its entity classes are Offer and its subclasses, Listing, the chat thread and DataStore. The screens hold no rule: they pass on what the buyer typed and show what comes back.

How a screen uses it, in the order of the use case: 


 OfferForm form = offers.start(listingId);                 // steps 1-4: available? what to suggest?
 Offer sent = offers.submitPriceOffer(listingId, typed);   // steps 5-9, for a sale listing
 Offer sent = offers.submitBorrowRequest(listingId, start, end);   // for a lend listing
 Offer sent = offers.submitClaim(listingId);               // for a giveaway: no form (step 3)
 OfferForm form = offers.startFromCounter(offerId);        // step 1, agreeing to a seller's counter

Defensive programming (Lecture 10). Everything that arrives here is untrusted: the price is still the text the buyer typed, a date may be missing, and the listing may have changed since the screen was drawn. The submit methods are the barricade: they check the terms (A2, A3) and the availability (A1) and refuse with a ServiceException written for the buyer. Behind the barricade the model classes take clean values, and their own checks (IllegalArgumentException) only guard against programming errors.

Atomic step (Special Requirement 2). The last availability check and the recording of the offer are one DataStore.transaction(java.util.function.Supplier<T>), so of two buyers who claim the same giveaway at the same moment only the first succeeds.

  • Method Details

    • start

      public OfferForm start(String listingId)
      Begins Make Offer on a listing, from the action button on its detail screen or the Make Offer option in its chat: checks that the listing is available and returns what the form starts with. For a sale that is the listing's price, for a lend listing a period that starts in a minute and lasts the listing's lending duration; the buyer corrects them.
      Throws:
      ListingUnavailableException - if the listing is not available (A1)

    • startFromCounter

      public OfferForm startFromCounter(String offerId)
      Begins Make Offer by agreeing to a seller's counter on one of the buyer's earlier offers (step 1): the form starts with the counter's price or dates (step 4). Submitting it makes a new offer for the seller to accept or decline; the countered offer itself stays as it is (Special Requirements 4 and 5).
      Throws:
      ServiceException - if there is no such offer of this buyer, or the seller has not countered it
      ListingUnavailableException - if the listing is not available (A1)

    • submitPriceOffer

      public Offer submitPriceOffer(String listingId, String price)
      Submits a price offer on a sale listing.
      Parameters:
      price - the price as the buyer typed it, in HK$
      Returns:
      the new offer, Pending
      Throws:
      ServiceException - if the price is empty, not a number or not positive (A2); nothing is recorded
      ListingUnavailableException - if the listing is no longer available (A1); nothing is recorded

    • submitBorrowRequest

      public Offer submitBorrowRequest(String listingId, LocalDateTime start, LocalDateTime end)
      Submits a borrow request on a lend listing, for the period from start to end.
      Parameters:
      start - null if the buyer gave no complete start date and time
      end - null if the buyer gave no complete end date and time
      Returns:
      the new borrow request, Pending
      Throws:
      ServiceException - if a date is missing, the start is in the past, or the period is shorter than the minimum borrow time (A3); the message says which
      ListingUnavailableException - if the listing is no longer available (A1)

    • submitClaim

      public Offer submitClaim(String listingId)
      Claims a giveaway with one action (Task 1.5); a claim has no terms to check.
      Returns:
      the new claim, Pending
      Throws:
      ListingUnavailableException - if the giveaway is no longer available, for example because another buyer's claim is pending (A1)
